channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: A massive wave of remote code execution vulnerabilities threatens global enterprise infrastructure today, driven primarily by heap-based buffer overflows, use-after-free flaws, and insecure deserialization in Microsoft's Windows kernel, network services, SQL Server, and Exchange ecosystem. Critical authentication bypasses and weak cryptographic validation in Active Directory Federation Services and Azure Key Vault expose identity management and cloud secrets to spoofing and unauthorized access, while wormable exploits in RPC and DNS protocols amplify the risk of rapid lateral movement. Beyond Microsoft environments, significant risks persist in third-party IoT devices containing hardcoded keys and command injection flaws, alongside widespread SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks compromising web applications and database middleware. The concentration of high-severity flaws in foundational networking, virtualization, and industrial control systems demands immediate remediation to prevent widespread service disruption and hardware compromise.
